categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: new energy battery business and surface engineering chemicals business. The new energy segment focuses on lithium-ion battery R&D, production, and sales, including energy storage batteries and systems, as well as integrated EPC services for photovoltaic and energy storage solutions. The surface engineering chemicals segment produces coating additives and intermediates used in automotive, machinery, electronics, coatings, construction, shipbuilding, and aerospace industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced lithium-ion battery technologies, including high-safety, long-life lithium iron phosphate cells (e.g., 314Ah cells) and modular energy storage systems. It has established multiple specialized laboratories for materials, cells, modules, and system integration, and uses ISO9001, IATF16949, ISO14001, and ISO45001 quality and environmental management systems. Production is order-driven with lean management and strict quality control, supported by strategic supplier partnerships to ensure stable raw material supply.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include downstream surface engineering processing enterprises and coating additive manufacturers, as well as clients in the new energy sector such as new energy vehicle manufacturers and energy storage system users. The company serves markets in automotive, industrial machinery, electronics, construction, and renewable energy sectors, with a focus on domestic Chinese regions and some overseas markets for home and commercial energy storage.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant sales in South China, East China, and Central China regions. It also has a small but growing presence in overseas markets, particularly for home energy storage products. Its headquarters and major production facilities are located in Hunan Province, with historical ties to Guangdong Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell production, module assembly, system integration, and providing comprehensive EPC services. It also produces chemical additives upstream for surface engineering applications, positioning itself as both a manufacturer and system integrator.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on expanding its energy storage battery and integrated system business, emphasizing high safety, long life, and cost-effectiveness. R&D priorities include developing new battery cells (e.g., 314Ah LFP cells), energy management systems (EMS), and diversified energy storage solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial applications. The company collaborates with universities and research institutes to accelerate innovation and enhance product competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of lithium-ion battery cells, modules, and integrated energy storage systems, as well as sales of surface engineering chemical products. The company also earns income from EPC contracts for integrated renewable energy and storage projects, and provides related technical and maintenance services. All sales are conducted primarily via direct sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition in the new energy battery sector, particularly in the power battery market, leading to a strategic shift towards higher-margin energy storage batteries and systems. It holds a competitive position by leveraging technological innovation, diversified product offerings, and integrated service capabilities. In surface engineering chemicals, it competes with smaller firms, benefiting from scale and quality certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 125.6 million, a 34% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 394.5 million, reflecting ongoing challenges including low capacity utilization and asset impairments. Total assets stood at RMB 1.46 billion with a decline in net assets. The company is in a restructuring phase focusing on energy storage, with significant R&D investment but facing short-term financial losses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high safety, long cycle life, and cost-effective lithium iron phosphate battery technologies tailored for diverse energy storage applications. Its integrated approach combining battery cells, system integration, and EPC services provides customers with comprehensive, customized renewable energy solutions. Quality certifications and strategic supplier partnerships ensure product reliability and supply stability, differentiating it in a competitive market.
